change_record: Addendum v6.0 after owner decisions D42 (design-v6 implementation round: editable payout cells + newest-first month columns, bond-attribute parity, dashboard status chips/filters, email presets + test route, returns history tab + Goals KPI link, inline move panel) and D43 (LOCKED app-wide sort standard Danger -> On-going -> Matured on every list surface, status taxonomy, automatic same-day Danger rule), both CONFIRMED/LOCKED in dk_bond_tracker_brainstorm_20261030 v2.6.0: adds TC-129..TC-137 (9 cases, all REMOTE) covering the F-233 implementability seams — payment editor maps to the existing POST /payment/<bond_id>/<month> route + payment_ledger; email test = NEW route persisting via alert_prefs; attribute fields = FR-40 set + broker ALTER; credit-day CHECK must migrate 1..28 -> 1..31; Goals #returns link needs view+tab JS; arch-v2 candidate whitelist predates D42 and is superseded on the attribute set. FR BINDING NOTE (brief 36c): docs/PRD_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v6.json (brief 36a, parallel) was NOT available at authoring time — the FR-67..FR-74 requirement ids used in test_bindings below are PROVISIONAL per the brief-36a planned allocation and MUST be re-verified against PRD v6 when it lands. Strategy: owner Q3 — ALL testing remote, GitHub Actions only, no local tier; gate = full suite green before merge. D42 note: TC-129..TC-137 each trace to a D42 scope item (editable payouts, month columns, attribute parity, dashboard chips, email presets, returns tab, move panel). D43 note: TC-131 is the D43 order gate over the five-surface table (dashboard/holdings/payouts/exports/print), TC-132 carries the D43 order inside the filtered dashboard set, and TC-135 carries it inside the returns tab.

test_cases.title: Payout cell edit saves through the existing payment route and status re-derives immediately
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed a holding with an unpaid current-month payout cell on the Payouts tab. 2. Click the cell; enter amount 7500; tick 'Received?'; click Save. 3. Assert the POST lands on the existing /payment/<bond_id>/<month> route and writes payment_ledger (amount=7500.0, paid=1). 4. Re-read payment_ledger and re-fetch the Payouts grid and My Holdings rows.
test_cases.expected: Ledger row persisted exactly once with no second writer; cell renders '7500 received (checkmark)'; the row's health re-derives immediately from the grid (a credit-day-missed row becomes On-going once the qualifying entry exists; an empty save renders Missed/Danger); D42 seam honored: existing payment POST + payment_ledger are the only truth.

test_cases.title: Payouts month headers are newest-first and never exceed the current month
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed ledger rows spanning several past months plus one future-dated ledger row. 2. GET /portfolio?tab=payouts. 3. Read the <th> month header order left to right. 4. Assert the first header is the current month, each following header is strictly older, and no header is after the current month (F-231 lesson).
test_cases.expected: Headers = [current month, previous, ...] newest-left; the future-dated row produces NO future header (elapsed + current only); caption states newest month first and future months never shown (D42 month-column rule).

test_cases.title: Dashboard, holdings, payouts, exports and print all emit Danger -> On-going -> Matured order (D43 — table of surfaces)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed a mixed row set: Danger, On-going, Matured and one Invalid. 2. For EACH surface capture row order: GET / (dashboard), GET /portfolio (My Holdings), GET /portfolio?tab=payouts, GET /export.csv, GET /print. 3. Assert every surface orders Danger first, On-going next, Matured last, Invalid last of all. 4. Assert the five surfaces agree with each other and with the shared sort key (no template-local ordering).
test_cases.expected: D43 table of surfaces — dashboard | holdings | payouts | exports | print — each emits the LOCKED D43 order Danger -> On-going -> Matured (Invalid after Matured); status taxonomy captions unchanged (Danger = immediate attention, On-going = normal, Matured = finished); automatic same-day Danger rows sort with Danger.

test_cases.title: Dashboard status filter chips All/Danger/On-going/Matured filter rows with exactly one active chip
test_cases.steps: 1. GET the dashboard Overview tab. 2. Assert four chips with exact labels All, Danger, On-going, Matured and All active by default. 3. Click each status chip and count visible chart rows by data-status. 4. Click All again.
test_cases.expected: Danger shows only Danger rows, On-going only On-going, Matured only Matured; All restores every row; exactly one chip active at a time; inside each filtered set rows keep the D43 priority order (D42 dashboard filter, subset of D43).

test_cases.title: Attribute parity roundtrip: candidate -> move -> holdings strip values are equal
test_cases.steps: 1. Add Candidate carrying rating agency, issuer type, secured, face value, payout cycle, invested amount, broker and source note. 2. Open the Watchlist Details facts grid and record every attribute value and label. 3. Move the candidate to Portfolio through the inline panel. 4. Read the My Holdings attribute strip row for the new position and the detail drawer.
test_cases.expected: Rating agency / Issuer type / Secured / Face value / Payout cycle / Broker / Source note render with identical values in the Details facts grid and in the holdings attribute strip (labels exact per design v6); the FR-40 display fields plus broker survive the move end-to-end (D42 attribute parity; F-233 seam: FR-40 set + broker ALTER).

test_cases.title: Email presets autofill exact SMTP values and the test-email route renders success and failure banner states
test_cases.steps: 1. Settings > Email: select Gmail; assert host, port and security autofill. 2. Select Outlook / Microsoft 365; re-assert the autofill values. 3. Select Custom; assert the three fields clear. 4. POST the NEW test-email route with a valid configuration; assert the success banner state. 5. Repeat with an empty SMTP host; assert the failure banner state. 6. Assert the attempt persists non-secret status via alert_prefs key/value and that no credential value appears in the banner.
test_cases.expected: Gmail autofills smtp.gmail.com / 587 / TLS; Outlook autofills smtp.office365.com / 587 / STARTTLS; Custom clears all three. Success banner state shows 'Test email sent. Check the inbox (and the spam folder).'; failure banner state shows 'Sending failed. Authentication failed = usually needs an App Password. Also check SMTP host, port and security setting.' (D42 email presets; F-233 seam: NEW route persisting via alert_prefs + mailer.py).

test_cases.title: Returns tab computes paid-dot-pending and cumulative running total and the Goals KPI link navigates to it
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed payment_ledger across at least three months with mixed paid/unpaid active positions. 2. Open Dashboard > Returns history tab. 3. Per month assert: interest received = sum of paid ledger entries that month; positions paid-dot-pending = paid count dot pending count of the active set; cumulative received = previous cumulative + this month's interest (first month = its own interest). 4. Assert newest month first, current month row highlighted with the Current chip, future months absent. 5. GET /goals and click 'View full returns history on Dashboard' on a KPI card.
test_cases.expected: Math exact on every row; the latest cumulative equals the Received stat-card value; after the link click the active view switches to Dashboard AND the Returns history tab is activated (view switch + tab activation contract, F-233 seam: needs view+tab JS) landing on the #returns card (D42 returns history + Goals KPI link).

test_cases.title: credit_day=31 is accepted after the CHECK migration and rejected before it
test_cases.steps: 1. Against a database created with the legacy CHECK (credit_day >= 1 AND credit_day <= 28): POST the move and add paths with credit_day=31. 2. Assert a 400 named error and zero rows written. 3. Run the schema CHECK migration to 1..31; assert sqlite_master shows CHECK (credit_day >= 1 AND credit_day <= 31) and every pre-existing row survives the rebuild. 4. Repeat both POSTs with credit_day=31; also probe credit_day=0 and 32.
test_cases.expected: Before migration: 400 named error, no insert. After migration: 302 and the row stores 31; values 1..31 all accepted while 0 and 32 stay rejected (D41 owner rule carried as the F-233 seam: credit-day CHECK must migrate 1..28 -> 1..31 or inserts of 31 fail).

test_cases.title: Move inline panel renders the exact FR-67..74-bound field labels below the row
test_cases.steps: 1. GET /watch. 2. Click Move to Portfolio on a candidate row. 3. Read the inline panel's field labels and action buttons. 4. Cancel and re-open to confirm the panel toggles below its own row.
test_cases.expected: Panel expands inline beneath its row (never stacked inside the cramped Action cell) with EXACT labels 'Purchase date (start date)', 'End date', 'Credit day — when the amount is credited each month', 'Broker' plus Move and Cancel actions, byte-identical to design v6 (D42 move-panel placement; FR bindings provisional — see change_record).
